title: Daily digest: Nampally Court Acquits NSUI State Presid | HDK hopeful of alliance partners fieldin | 15,627 social media posts removed since
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Nampally Court Acquits NSUI State President in 2020 Case.
HDK hopeful of alliance partners fielding consensus NDA candidate for Hiriyur bypolls.
15,627 social media posts removed since UDF came into power, government reveals in Assembly.
bullets_ur: Nampally Court ne 2020 ke muamlay mein NSUI State President ko bari kar diya
HDK ko umeed hai ke alliance partners Hiriyur bypolls ke liye consensus NDA candidate utaray gay.
UDF ki hukumat aanay ke baad se social media ki 15,627 posts hata di gayin, hukumat ne Assembly mein bata diya.
